units.source_text: 这女子不是从体育场内，而是从体育场外的一条路走过来的。

en.t: The woman had not come from inside the stadium, but had walked over along a road outside it.

units.source_text: 这条路与住宅区毗连，比体育场的地面约莫低二尺。

en.t: This road bordered the residential district and was about two feet lower than the ground of the stadium.
